North Plains Veterinary Clinic has served pet owners in North Plains, Oregon for over 20 years. Our main focus is to educate pet parents and provide the best care for their pets.

Our veterinarian, Dr. Thomas Tsui, is able to offer a wide variety of surgical and medical care for small pets. We know you care about your animal's well-being and we promise that you can trust they're happy and healthy in our hands.

Starting a YouTube Channel was part of our promise to provide top of the line care & education. Check back here for more updated videos on things we feel passionately about -- even if it's just cute pet videos!
